hero.title: Cronos executes controversial blockchain rollback to recover crypto worth $111 million
hero.description: Validators rolled back nearly two hours of blockchain history to recover user assets. But the attackers still managed to get away with $9.19 million before Cronos halted the network.

latest.title: Bitcoin slips to $78,800 as BNB and DeFi tokens buck the selloff
latest.description: Bitcoin fell 0.42% since midnight UTC to $78,874, but the CoinDesk 20 rose 0.2% and the memecoin index gained 0.41% as BNB Chain tokens rallied.

latest.title: Uzbekistan begins government bond-backed stablecoin payment pilot
latest.description: Humo Digital will test HUMO payments with more than 20 merchants under a sandbox jointly overseen by NAPP and Uzbekistan’s central bank.

latest.title: Ledger CTO urges AI bug hunter responsibility, warns against ‘attention farming’
latest.description: Ledger and Trezor said researchers have a responsibility to publish their findings if vendors fail to fix bugs within an agreed disclosure window.

latest.title: Polish Court Detains Fifth Suspect in Zondacrypto Exchange Probe
latest.description: Two chief executives of the exchange have now vanished, four years apart, leaving 1.3 million clients locked out.

latest.title: Robinhood chain to generate $160M in annual fees by 2028: Bernstein
latest.description: Growing demand for tokenized stock trading may drive the Robinhood chain’s annual fees to $160 million by 2028, predicted analysts from Bernstein.

latest.title: Stablecoins could save South Korean merchants up to $3.8 billion a year, budget office says
latest.description: South Korea’s budget office warned that stablecoin adoption could reduce banks' roles as credit intermediaries and potentially destabilize token pegs during mass redemptions.

latest.title: New Bitcoin whales spark sell-side risk as unrealized gains hit $9B
latest.description: Unrealized gains by whale speculators hit their highest levels on record last week, per data going back to 2016.

latest.title: Tracking cocoa may be just the beginning for PwC, Merck, Hashgraph provenance system
latest.description: The firms say their combination of physical authentication, digital traceability and enterprise process design has no precedent in supply chains, and cocoa is just the start.

latest.title: Pharma major Novartis falls 9% after three drug trial setbacks
latest.description: Shares of Novartis tanked on Tuesday after results from its del-desiran drug trial disappointed investors.

latest.title: TSMC, Samsung commit to ASML’s newest chipmaking tools as AI drives demand
